summary: The note is a short Wikipedia-style entry describing the West Quartzite Range, a mountain range in Antarctica. It is the western of two parallel quartzite ranges and lies on the east side of Houliston Glacier within the Concord Mountains. The range was named by the Northern Party of the NZFMCAE for its distinctive geological formation.
one_line: West Quartzite Range is a Antarctic mountain range, the western of two parallel quartzite ranges in the Concord Mountains near Houliston Glacier.
key_facts: West Quartzite Range is a mountain range in Antarctica.
West Quartzite Range is the western of two parallel quartzite ranges.
West Quartzite Range is situated at the east side of Houliston Glacier.
West Quartzite Range is located in the Concord Mountains, Antarctica.
West Quartzite Range was named by the Northern Party of NZFMCAE, 1962–63.
The range was named after the distinctive geological formation of the feature.
Houliston Glacier is the glacier on whose east side West Quartzite Range is situated.
The Concord Mountains are the mountain group in which West Quartzite Range is located.
